sentences.text: The in-force gold-loan FAQ describes a gold loan as a loan granted against the security of gold ornaments pledged with the Bank, but it does not state any processing fee for gold loans.
The in-force UCB responsible business conduct directions show a processing-charges table header, but the cited table excerpt does not provide a gold-loan-specific fee amount.
A processing fee of ₹400 appears in the bank’s home-loan agreement, but that document is for home loans and does not answer the gold-loan question.
I could not find a gold-loan processing-fee amount in the in-force gold-loan FAQ or the in-force processing-charges table.

missing.searched: in-force gold-loan FAQ and in-force processing-charges table
